source_locator.edition_or_translation: 1937 first edition; English translation by Panditabhushana V. Subrahmanya Sastri; Sanskrit text; Aruna Press, Bangalore

alternative_conditions.also_required: the referenced fifth places are devoid of benefics or benefic aspects

alternative_conditions.trigger: malefics on both sides of the referenced fifth places
alternative_conditions.also_required: the lords of those fifth places are in Dussthanas (6th, 8th, or 12th)

normalized_rule: The source says the fifth places from the Lagna, Jupiter, and Moon produce no issue when they are afflicted by malefics and devoid of benefics or their aspects, or when they are surrounded by malefics and their lords are in the 6th, 8th, or 12th.
synthesis_notes: This is a Mantreswara/Phaladeepika proposition, not a universal Jyotisha claim or a scientific statement.
review_notes: The two source alternatives are conjunctive; do not turn malefic affliction, benefic absence, or Dussthana lordship into independent triggers.
transmission_notes: The 1937 Sastri English translation is used as a reference-only source layer. The title page records a copyright registration while the Internet Archive metadata labels the scan public domain; no bulk text is stored. The normalized rule is original wording based on the cited passage, and printed-page mapping for individual verses is not asserted here.
